highlights_headline: SkiaSharp 4.148.0 is the first stable v4 release, built on Skia m148 with variable fonts and animated WebP.
highlights_body: It lands the entire v4 breaking-change set — legacy SKPaint text/font APIs become compile errors, Vulkan requires 1.1, and several type and struct signatures changed. The release also delivers variable font shaping, animated WebP encoding, Linux Bionic native assets, and a reworked singleton lifecycle.

breaking.title: Pre-v4 SKPaint text/font APIs are now compile errors
breaking.body: The text and font state members on SKPaint obsoleted in v3 (Typeface, TextSize, TextSkewX, etc.) are promoted to compile-time errors. Move text configuration onto SKFont and pass it to the drawing methods. Remove all references to SKPaint's font/text properties; the compiler will point out every site that needs updating.

breaking.title: SKFont and SKPaint default typeface is no longer null
breaking.body: new SKFont() now stores SKTypeface.Empty instead of resolving lazily at draw time — MeasureText returns 0 and nothing draws if you omit the typeface. new SKPaint().Typeface returns SKTypeface.Default (non-null). Replace == null checks with .IsEmpty and construct fonts with an explicit typeface: new SKFont(SKTypeface.Default).

breaking.title: GRContext.CreateVulkan aborts the process on Vulkan 1.0 devices
breaking.body: Skia m132+ requires Vulkan 1.1. Passing a 1.0 instance or leaving GRVkBackendContext.MaxAPIVersion at 0 now calls SK_ABORT and terminates the process — it is not catchable. Set VkApplicationInfo.apiVersion and MaxAPIVersion to VK_API_VERSION_1_1 (0x00401000). Devices that cannot reach 1.1 must fall back to the raster backend.

breaking.title: GRVkBackendContextNative fields removed
breaking.body: fMinAPIVersion, fInstanceVersion, fExtensions, fFeatures, and fOwnsInstanceAndDevice were removed from GRVkBackendContextNative. Use fVkExtensions in place of fExtensions and fDeviceFeatures/fDeviceFeatures2 in place of fFeatures. Skia no longer manages instance/device ownership through the context struct.

breaking.title: GRVkImageInfo.YcbcrConversionInfo type changed; GrVkYcbcrConversionInfo loses value equality
breaking.body: The property type changed from GrVkYcbcrConversionInfo to GRVkYcbcrConversionInfo. GrVkYcbcrConversionInfo no longer implements IEquatable and its == / != operators are removed. Update struct references and remove equality comparisons on this type.

bullets.detail: The bundled Skia engine advances through milestones m132, m133, m147, and m148, bringing upstream rendering improvements, bug fixes, and the new GPU API prerequisites that enable Graphite in future releases.
Two cherry-pick syncs from the chrome/m147 branch apply additional engine-level stability and correctness fixes on top of the milestone bump.

bullets.lead: Variable font support in SkiaSharp and HarfBuzzSharp
bullets.detail: Consumers can now load and use variable fonts: set axis values on SKTypeface, enumerate font axes, and use OpenType variable shaping through HarfBuzzSharp. Color font palette access is also exposed.
SKWebpEncoder gains animated WebP output: encode a sequence of frames into a single .webp file with per-frame timing, quality, and loop-count control.

SKStream.GetData() returns the underlying SKData without copying when the stream already wraps a data object, and falls back to a buffered read otherwise — a useful optimisation for pipeline steps that work directly with SKData.

bullets.lead: HBColor struct for color palette values
bullets.detail: A new HBColor value type properly wraps hb_color_t, replacing the previous uint representation and giving color palette API a typed, documented surface.

bullets.lead: SKSamplingOptions added to SKSurface.Draw and SKCanvas.DrawSurface
bullets.detail: Overloads of DrawSurface now accept an SKSamplingOptions parameter, giving callers control over the interpolation filter used when compositing surfaces.

bullets.lead: Missing API wrappers and naming corrections
bullets.detail: Several previously unreachable native entry points are now wrapped, and a number of binding names that violated the SkiaSharp naming convention are corrected.

bullets.lead: SKPixmap/SKBitmap GetPixelSpan stride and offset corrected
bullets.detail: GetPixelSpan used Height instead of Width for the x-axis offset, and did not use RowBytes for stride — both are now fixed, preventing silent pixel-data corruption when accessing non-square or padded bitmaps.

bullets.lead: SKPath finalizer crash when SKPathBuilder is collected first
bullets.detail: A native use-after-free in the SKPath finalizer triggered when the GC collected SKPathBuilder before SKPath. The object graph is now rooted correctly.

bullets.lead: WinUI Projection DLL not found for .NET 9 consumers
bullets.detail: SkiaSharp.Views.WinUI failed to locate the WinUI Projection DLL under .NET 9 due to a path resolution change. The lookup is now corrected.
Library TFMs are set to version 26.0 and app TFMs use the unversioned form, matching Apple's SDK conventions and fixing spurious TFM mismatches.

bullets.lead: Android SKGLView stops rendering after tab switch in MAUI TabBar
bullets.detail: The OpenGL view surface was not correctly re-established after a MAUI TabBar navigation away and back. The surface lifecycle is now handled correctly.

The lifetime management of SkiaSharp singleton objects (font managers, image filters, etc.) is redesigned to be deterministic and finalizer-safe, eliminating a class of use-after-free that appeared under GC pressure.

bullets.lead: Native-compat gate moved to SkiaApi constructor
bullets.detail: The check that validates the native library version is now in the SkiaApi type constructor rather than a ModuleInitializer, making the error easier to surface and diagnose at startup.
Pre-built native libraries are now shipped for Linux Bionic (Android-derived userspace), enabling SkiaSharp on non-Android systems that use the Bionic C library.

bullets.lead: Tizen x64 and arm64 native build support
bullets.detail: The Tizen platform now builds and ships native libraries for both x64 and arm64 architectures, completing Tizen multi-architecture coverage.
Native WASM builds for Emscripten versions targeting pre-.NET 8 runtimes are removed. .NET 8+ (Emscripten 3.1.34+) remains fully supported.
Bundled native libraries are updated: expat to 2.8.1, libexpat to 2.7.5, libpng to 1.6.58, freetype to 2.14.3, zlib to 1.3.2.1-motley, libjpeg-turbo to 3.1.4.1, and HarfBuzz to 14.2.0.

contributor_summaries.ramezgerges: Variable font shaping, color palette support, singleton lifecycle rework, SKPaint text/font obsoletes promotion, the SKPath finalizer fix, Skia milestone bump to m147, default-typeface resolution fix, and Uno gallery sample maintenance.
contributor_summaries.4Darmygeometry: Linux Bionic native assets support and PolySharp integration for C# 13 language features on legacy TFMs.
contributor_summaries.ebariche: Reduced SkiaFiddle WASM application size by approximately 60% through bundle optimisations.
contributor_summaries.sasakrsmanovic: Updated the Uno Platform link and description in the project README.
contributor_summaries.SimonvBez: Fixed SKGLView not re-rendering after a tab switch in a MAUI TabBar on Android.

preview_summaries.v4.148.0-rc.1.2: Release Candidate 1 promoted the remaining pre-v4 SKPaint text/font obsoletes to compile errors, trimmed obsolete enums from the ref assembly, moved the native-compat gate to the SkiaApi constructor, updated expat to 2.8.1, and merged the final Skia m148 stability fixes.
preview_summaries.v4.147.0-preview.3.1: Preview 3 added HBColor, SKStream.GetData(), missing API wrappers, updated libjpeg-turbo to 3.1.4.1, dropped pre-.NET 8 WASM targets, and refreshed the .NET SDK.
preview_summaries.v4.147.0-preview.2.1: Preview 2 delivered animated WebP encoding, the SKPath finalizer fix, GetPixelSpan stride and offset corrections, and Apple platform TFM alignment.
preview_summaries.v4.147.0-preview.1.1: Preview 1 opened the v4 line from v3.119.4, introducing variable fonts, color font palettes, Skia milestone advancement through m148, the singleton lifecycle rework, Linux Bionic native assets, Tizen arm64/x64 support, and native dependency refreshes.

harfbuzz_summary: HarfBuzzSharp 14.2.0 adds variable font shaping, an HBColor value type for color palette access, and enables the HarfBuzz binding on new platforms including Linux Bionic and Tizen arm64/x64.
